runestone.name: Almighty Bolt
runestone.text: A powerful bolt of arcane energy that does 160 damage to health, Magicka, and Stamina. 3 Arcane Runestone for a single use enchantment.

runestone.name: Baleful Glow
runestone.text: A powerful nether shockwave dealing 80 points of damage. Targets flee from combat for 5 seconds. 2 Tenebrous Runestone for a 30 seconds enchantment.

runestone.name: Havoc
runestone.text: A powerful kinetic shockwave dealing 80 points of damage. Pushes, disarms, and staggers nearby targets. 2 Arcane Runestone for a single use enchantment.

runestone.name: Runestorm
runestone.text: A storm of arcane blades dealing 15 damage, and up to quadruple the amount to those with low Magic Resistance. 2 Arcane Runestone for a single use enchantment.

runestone.name: Spectral Slash
runestone.text: A blade of nether energy dealing 20 points of damage. Absorbs 20 points of Health. 1 Tenebrous Runestone for a 30 seconds enchantment.

runestone.name: Stunning Blast
runestone.text: Arcane energy leaps between targets, dealing 10 points of damage. Targets periodically stagger. 1 Arcane Runestone for a 30 seconds enchantment.

runestone.name: Sundering Inferno
runestone.text: An ethereal blaze dealing 80 points of damage. Lowers Magic Resistance by 30 for 30 seconds. 2 Arcane Runestone for a single use enchantment.

runestone.name: Transfer Rune
runestone.text: Allows runic enchantments to apply to nearby allies as well when cast. 1 Arcane Runestone for a 360 seconds magic effect.

runestone.name: Umbral Veil
